name: Header
summary: Top bar with logo, main navigation, search and actions. A link with a menu opens a Mega menu. Below 900px the links and the search move into a Slideout behind a menu button, with Mobile nav. Logo and Navigation are native Figma slots.
use: Websites and apps with a few main sections.
avoid: Apps with many sections or deep navigation: use Sidebar.
anatomy: Navigation (slot) with Header nav items. An item with Has menu opens a Mega menu.
Search (optional, Show search): a Search input sm of 240 px.
figmaProps: Logo holds a _Logo instance (Size=Large, tagline off). Select it in the slot to turn the tagline on or to swap in your own logo.
Show navigation / Show menu button / Show search
Via _Header. Show search is off by default.
Expanded: its Mega menu is open.
reactProps: menu: { columns, featured? } opens a Mega menu; the item becomes a button. icon is deprecated (the mobile menu uses Mobile nav).
Usually a SearchInput (size sm). Right side on desktop, top of the mobile menu.
Name of the navigation. Default 'Main menu'. navLabel is deprecated.
Default 'Open menu', 'Menu'. menuLabel and menuTitle are deprecated.
behaviour: Desktop: links in the bar. A link with a menu opens its Mega menu on click (or Enter/Space). Escape, a click outside, focus leaving the navigation or a click on a link closes it. One menu is open at a time.
Mobile: the menu button opens a Slideout "Menu" with the search and Mobile nav.
a11y: <header> with a <nav aria-label>. Current page with aria-current="page".
An item with a menu is a <button aria-expanded aria-controls>. The panel follows it in the tab order and holds plain links (a disclosure, not an ARIA menu): Tab works as usual, no arrow keys needed.
Escape moves focus back to the button.
The search is a separate role="search" landmark, next to the navigation.
The menu button has aria-expanded and aria-haspopup="dialog".
content: 5 to 6 links at most, with short names.
do: Keep the same order on desktop and mobile.
dont: Mix actions and navigation in the row of links.
